svg.aria-label: FlowLab learned density and shared-axis sample audit

g.text: FlowLab | exact model density, imperfect fit
Banana-shaped synthetic data. Same axes: x from -3 to 3, y from -2 to 5. 256 samples per panel.
Test generating-reference NLL: 2.1514 nats/2-D point. Trained flow: 2.1884. Exact density is not a perfect fit.
Curve residual = y - 0.6(x squared - 1). These descriptive sample summaries are not calibrated coverage.
One development fixture, no setting/seed sweep or real-data benchmark. Curve line is the known generator mean.
